lattice_menu.doc: The Lattice page (M2-MNU-01; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Lattice page). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3. 'board' holds the LatticeBoardView drawing metrics in reference px (unit_px: one lattice unit; node shapes are half-diagonals of a lozenge), the camera pan time, the mouse's zoom (zoom_min / zoom_max: the scale the wheel stops at; zoom_step: one notch's factor) and drag (drag_px: how far a press moves before it pans instead of clicking; M2-UI-26), the direction-pick cone (cone_cos: the cosine of the widest angle off the pressed direction; angle_weight: how much a slanted node counts as farther) and the palette role of each board region (theme colours of type Hymn, never hard-coded). 'portrait' (M2-MNU-301) is the hero on show's head (a face-cropped HeroPortraitFrame) right of the 'hero' line. 'side' is the details panel, 'legend' the key (each node look, drawn as the board draws it, and its meaning; its rect is where it sits when the lines above end higher, else it follows them, and it shows only its first rows that end side.foot_gap above the foot, hiding when fewer than min_rows fit), 'status' the foot (the last result or refusal), and 'confirm' the two-row MenuPage that takes its place before anything is spent.

overview.doc: M3-MNU-04: the whole-board view. 'action' is added to the InputMap when missing (FieldInput.add_actions; remappable on the Controls page, menu context: M and pad X are free there). The view fits every node inside the board view less margin_px a side (zoom held between board zoom_min and zoom_max) and centres the board; it moves over pan_sec (board) unless motion is reduced. Each hero's name sits in a tag name_gap_px under their node (tags on one node stack by name_step_px), and every woken node carries the initials of the heroes who woke it, its top-left initials_offset right of and below the node's right point (clear of its neighbours). 'button' is the mouse affordance, a framed button in the title bar.
